title: Native sequence visibility produces false 100% recovery
what_happened: First ProteinSolver run showed 100% sequence recovery. Investigation revealed data.y contained the native sequence, and protein_design.py copied it position-by-position via strategy='ref'.
lesson: A native-sequence-visible run is NOT valid all-masked inverse-folding recovery. Always distinguish diagnostic scoring (natives visible) from true recovery (all residues masked).
trigger: Any experiment reporting sequence recovery metrics
evidence_scope: Demonstrated on 1n5uA03 via EXP004 mask invariance test

title: PyG Data vs Batch interface mismatch crashes design_sequence
what_happened: ProteinSolver's design_sequence expected data.batch attribute (from PyG Batch). In PyG 2.x, plain Data objects have data.batch=None, causing 'NoneType has no attribute max' crash.
lesson: Always use Batch.from_data_list([data]) before calling functions that expect batch-level attributes. Check interface contracts before passing data between components.
trigger: Using PyG Data objects with functions expecting Batch
evidence_scope: Observed and fixed during ProteinSolver integration

title: Modern runtime != historical runtime equivalence
what_happened: Initial reports described ProteinSolver execution as 'reproduced'. Hardening review identified this overclaimed historical numerical equivalence that was never tested.
lesson: Use 'FUNCTIONALLY REPRODUCED WITH MODERN COMPATIBILITY ADAPTATION'. Never claim historical runtime equivalence without actually comparing outputs against the original Python 3.6 / PyG 1.3 / Linux stack.
evidence_scope: Hardening pass identified multiple instances across project docs

title: Single-target result is not a benchmark
what_happened: 41.30% recovery on 1n5uA03 (one 92-AA CATH domain) was at risk of being described as benchmark performance.
lesson: A single-target result is a 'single-target all-masked inverse-folding integration result'. It is NOT benchmark accuracy, generalization performance, or representative of average behavior across folds.
trigger: Reporting evaluation results from fewer than a representative benchmark set
evidence_scope: 1n5uA03 result established in EXP000/EXP001

title: Training set membership is not verifiable from accessible metadata
what_happened: Author's notebook checked '1.10.246.10' in cath_ids (False), but the full 72M training Parquet corpus is on an external cluster, not in git.
lesson: Do not call 1n5uA03 'guaranteed held-out' or 'unseen'. Classify as 'NOT VERIFIABLE FROM ACCESSIBLE METADATA' unless full training data is directly queried.
trigger: Any claim about training/test membership of a structure
evidence_scope: Author's notebook check is suggestive but not definitive

title: Historical source repository must remain preserved and clean
what_happened: All six compatibility issues (fcntl, kmtools, scatter_, Batch, key mapping, CPU placement) were resolved without modifying external/proteinsolver-original/.
lesson: Never commit changes to external/proteinsolver-original/. All compatibility work belongs in external wrappers. Check git -C external/proteinsolver-original status before every project commit.
trigger: Any modification near external/ or compatibility shims
evidence_scope: Verified clean at commit 69ef0965

title: Current scientific protocol authority hierarchy
what_happened: Past reports and draft logs drifted from authoritative pre-registration and actual manifest artifacts, creating conflicting target lists and comparator definitions.
lesson: Current scientific protocol authority order is strictly: 1. Actual committed code/manifests, 2. science/PREREGISTRATION.md, 3. DECISION_LOG.md, 4. PROJECT_STATE.md, 5. Specifications, 6. Reports/summaries as derived artifacts. Reports never override pre-registration.
trigger: Any protocol reconciliation, reporting, or state update
evidence_scope: Observed during pre-E1 reconciliation audit passes

title: Development N=20 and Confirmatory N=50 sample sizes must never be conflated
what_happened: Reports and draft notes repeatedly conflated the development/tuning split (N_dev=20 CATH 4.2 validation backbones) with the primary confirmatory test set (N=50 TS50 targets).
lesson: N=20 is strictly reserved for development hyperparameter selection (T*, lambda*, gamma*). The primary confirmatory hypothesis test operates strictly on N=50 TS50 targets. Stratified de novo set is N=15.
trigger: Statistical testing specification or target reporting
evidence_scope: Observed in pre-E1 reconciliation reports and audit findings

title: Primary confirmatory comparator is strictly Hybrid vs MPNN-only
what_happened: The phrase 'Best Single Model' was inadvertently used in draft summaries to describe the primary comparison, creating ambiguity about post-hoc model selection.
lesson: The authoritative confirmatory comparison is strictly d_t = scTM_hybrid(t) - scTM_MPNN-only(t). 'Best Single Model' must NEVER appear as the definition of the primary confirmatory comparator unless explicitly designated as a separate exploratory analysis.
trigger: Specifying primary hypothesis tests or benchmark comparisons
evidence_scope: Identified in V4 pre-E1 audit checks

title: Confirmatory benchmark screening requires a single frozen execution path
what_happened: Documentation contained potential degrees of freedom allowing silent CPU fallback and multiple chunk sizes (128 vs 64) for ESMFold screening.
lesson: The confirmatory benchmark must follow one and only one frozen execution path: GPU float16 with chunk_size=128. If GPU is unavailable or OOM occurs, it must be logged as INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, never silently switching precision or chunk size. CPU float32 and chunk size 64 are non-confirmatory diagnostics only.
trigger: Structural oracle configuration and screening execution
evidence_scope: Audited in ESMFold configuration closure pass

title: Hydrophobic core fraction denominator must be total hydrophobic residues
what_happened: Implementation in src/hybrid/selection.py used sequence length L as the denominator while protocol documentation used total hydrophobic residues.
lesson: Hydrophobic core fraction is formally f_core = (hydrophobic residues with RSA < 0.20) / (total hydrophobic residues in {V, L, I, F, M, W}). If total hydrophobic residues is 0, return 0.0. It must never be described as 'hydrophobic-core density'.
evidence_scope: Identified and fixed in src/hybrid/selection.py and unit-tested in tests/test_scientific_protocol.py

title: Differentiate audit-start HEAD from final committed HEAD in reports
what_happened: Previous pre-E1 closure reports labelled ancestor commit SHAs as 'Current HEAD' while also describing them as 'prior to this commit'.
lesson: In closure and readiness reports, always record audit-start HEAD separately from the final committed HEAD produced by the repair pass. 'Current HEAD' must never refer to an ancestor.
trigger: Audit reporting and Git state verification
evidence_scope: Identified in V4 closure report and corrected in V5

title: Project Truth authority is scoped to verified facts and limitations, not protocol
what_happened: docs/PROJECT_TRUTH.md contained a blanket claim that all project documents defer to it on conflict, creating a potential authority collision with science/PREREGISTRATION.md.
lesson: PROJECT_TRUTH.md is the authoritative record of verified implementation facts, evidence status, and known limitations. Scientific protocol authority is strictly science/PREREGISTRATION.md, and chronological decision provenance is DECISION_LOG.md.
evidence_scope: Reconciled in docs/PROJECT_TRUTH.md and unit-tested in tests/test_scientific_protocol.py

title: Statistical implementation defaults must be explicitly frozen
what_happened: Protocol specified asymptotic normal approximation with continuity correction for Wilcoxon test, but raw scipy.stats.wilcoxon call omitted method='asymptotic', relying on implicit SciPy defaults.
lesson: Always explicitly pass all statistical parameters (method='asymptotic', zero_method='wilcox', correction=True, alternative='two-sided') in code and validate finite inputs (rejecting NaN/inf) to eliminate runtime variance.
evidence_scope: Implemented in src/hybrid/statistics.py and verified in tests/test_scientific_protocol.py

title: Retry semantics must strictly preserve identical frozen configuration
what_happened: Vague phrasing 'retry under clean execution parameters' left open whether precision, device, chunking, or seeds could be altered upon runtime failure.
lesson: A retry is defined strictly as retrying exactly once with the identical frozen model, checkpoint, version, precision, device, chunk size, seed, input, timeout, and protocol configuration. Only process restart and resource cleanup are permitted.
evidence_scope: Codified across PREREGISTRATION.md, evaluation_protocol.md, and metrics.md

title: Development oracle infrastructure failures require J = -infinity ineligibility
what_happened: Distinction between candidate-level screening failure and development AF2 validation failure needed formal specification for objective J calculation.
lesson: Development objective J requires complete M=10 validated library on all 20 dev targets. If an AF2 validation fails for infrastructure reasons, retry once; if unresolved, target cannot produce complete M=10 set, assigning J = -infinity (ineligible for argmax). Never assign scTM=0.0 or regenerate.
evidence_scope: Implemented in compute_development_target_sctm_mean in src/hybrid/optimization.py

title: Notebook presence or filenames are not proof of execution
what_happened: Early literature summaries inferred experimental coverage from notebook filenames without verifying whether notebook cells had been executed or contained real outputs.
lesson: Never use notebook presence or filenames as proof of execution - inspect cell execution counts and actual outputs to verify whether a notebook was executed or merely authored.
evidence_scope: documentation

title: Separate published-checkpoint reproduction from retraining
what_happened: Early planning discussions repeatedly raised retraining the 72M model from scratch, even though all published paper figures, designs, and biophysical evaluations used the published pretrained checkpoint.
lesson: Always separate published-checkpoint reproduction from retraining - the published checkpoint reproduces all inference, generation, biophysical scoring, and design validation; retraining is only required for training loss trajectories and is forbidden by default under DEC-004.
evidence_scope: architecture

title: Map paper figures to actual code and data provenance
what_happened: Earlier reports conflated passing a single-target 1n5uA03 integration fixture with reproducing the paper's multi-target, mutational, and biophysical benchmarks.
lesson: Always map paper figures to actual code and data provenance rather than inferring coverage from integration test fixtures.
evidence_scope: documentation

title: Never silently substitute modern tools for historical baselines
what_happened: Proposals were made to replace historical QUARK ab initio folding and Rosetta FastRelax with ESMFold/AlphaFold2 without noting the change in scientific scoring potentials.
lesson: Never silently substitute a modern tool (e.g. ESMFold/AlphaFold2 for QUARK/Rosetta/Modeller) without explicitly classifying it as MODERN_EQUIVALENT_NOT_EXACT_HISTORICAL_REPRODUCTION.
evidence_scope: science

title: Final published-paper figure numbering must be treated as independent from preprint/protocol/notebook numbering
what_happened: During initial provenance audits, internal notebook figure names and protocol figure numbers were erroneously assumed to match final Cell Systems published paper figure panels, leading to incorrect figure crosswalks.
lesson: Final published-paper figure panels must always be verified directly against the published journal PDF, completely independent of preprint, companion protocol, or internal notebook numbering.
evidence_scope: documentation

title: Reconcile executed command and input data paths against final report evidence descriptions before declaring reproduction complete
what_happened: In earlier audit reports, documentation cited non-existent or differently named datasets (e.g. protherm_wresults.parquet N=3,524) while the actual executed script consumed a different local file (protherm_design_wt_RUE.csv N=3,471).
lesson: Always verify that every dataset filename, path, and row count cited in documentation corresponds exactly to the raw file and script that actually executed before registering reproduction status.
evidence_scope: documentation

title: A non-significant p-value (p > 0.05) indicates failure to detect a difference, never proof of structural equivalence
what_happened: Early CD deconvolution reproduction reports asserted that because two-sample t-tests yielded p > 0.05, structural equivalence was rigorously confirmed.
lesson: Never report p > 0.05 as proof of structural equivalence - report strictly that no statistically significant difference was detected under the tested experimental and analytical conditions.
evidence_scope: science

title: Internally consistent reports can be globally false if assumptions are not verified against primary publications and source code
what_happened: In phases R1.0 through R1.2, cross-AI reports maintained internal consistency while propagating critical errors (hallucinating main Figures 3-5, positive EEHEE round 4 correlations, NMR structure determination, and ungrounded 4.4M sequence counts) because audits summarized prior AI reports rather than checking the primary Cell Systems publication and historical code.
lesson: Always verify architectural specifications, dataset sizes, statistical values, and figure numbers directly against primary source code and published peer-reviewed PDFs; never infer primary facts from AI report consensus or notebook naming.
evidence_scope: documentation

title: Primary-paper panel inventories must be verified at individual panel level, not merely figure-number level
what_happened: In previous audit cycles, figure numbers (e.g. Figure 1, Figure 2) were correctly identified, but sub-panels were misattributed (e.g. citing Figure 1A-E instead of 1A-C, describing Figure 2A as loss instead of accuracy, or inserting SEC/SDS-PAGE into panels 2G-M without paper caption confirmation).
lesson: Primary-paper panel inventories must be verified at the individual panel level against original captions, not merely at the figure-number level, because a correct figure number can still contain an incorrect panel-to-method mapping.
evidence_scope: documentation
source: Phase R1 Final Surgical Correction & Release Gate

title: Never infer implementation-level tensor architecture from prose summaries; verify tensor shapes directly from primary source code
what_happened: In previous audit cycles, paper prose mentioning distance and sequence separation was assumed to mean 3 input edge features and native self-loops, when primary source code in fact constructed a 2-channel normalized tensor entering an embedding MLP and explicitly stripped self-loops. Furthermore, reports declared R2_READY based on internal agreement between derived documents rather than verifying against primary code and cryptographic hashes.
lesson: Never infer implementation-level architecture from prose summaries when exact historical source code is available. Distinguish conceptual paper attributes from implementation-level tensor representation, verify tensor shapes directly from code, and never declare evidence closure merely because current documents agree with one another without primary-source grounding.
evidence_scope: implementation
source: Phase R1 Final Source Adjudication & Contradiction Elimination

title: Do not assume cloud-hosted datasets persist indefinitely
what_happened: During Phase R2, the published 10,000-instance test dataset hosted on Google Cloud Storage (gs://deep-protein-gen) was found to return HTTP 403 Forbidden, making the primary paper test dataset unreachable via that backend path.
lesson: Cloud-hosted datasets in public object storage buckets (GCS/S3) may change permissions, decay, or expire without notice. High-value benchmark and test partitions must be preserved in permanent archival repositories (e.g. Zenodo) or local version-controlled caches.

title: Legacy data-route invariant: Test documented distribution endpoints before declaring datasets unrecoverable
what_happened: The GCS storage path gs://deep-protein-gen returned HTTP 403, prompting an assumption of total dataset unavailability. However, testing the official author-documented legacy HTTP/HTTPS endpoint http://deep-protein-gen.data.proteinsolver.org/ revealed that the server is online and serving files (with expired TLS cert), providing access to directory listings and candidate parquet files.
lesson: When an official upstream repository documents a legacy dataset URL separately from an underlying cloud-storage path, test the documented distribution endpoint before declaring the dataset unrecoverable. HTTP failure on one backend endpoint does not prove failure of the documented public distribution route.
source: Phase R2.1 Legacy Data Route Verification

title: Current-authority regression sweeps must test both factual claims and status/authorization language
what_happened: In the completed Phase R2.1 report, while scientific claims, target crosswalks, and mathematical metrics were rigorously reconciled, the final recommendations section retained a stale sentence stating to proceed to downstream scientific campaigns, inadvertently implying automatic downstream phase authorization when Phase R2 evidence was strictly frozen at R2_PARTIAL.
lesson: Current-authority regression sweeps must test both factual claims and status/authorization language. A technically correct report can still become operationally misleading if it implies a downstream phase is authorized when it is not. Next-step recommendations in closure reports must enforce strict project decision boundaries.
source: Phase R2.1 Final Closure Integrity Gate

title: Agreement of summary statistics or record counts does not prove identity of underlying population
what_happened: In DEC-020, verifying that candidate validation partition data contained 1,331 rows yielding 1,283 valid records was described as matching notebook 06, conflating agreement of a summary record count with proof of row-level population identity.
lesson: Agreement of a summary count or aggregate metric across datasets is necessary but not sufficient to establish identity of individual population members. Unless row-level identity has been cryptographically or deterministically verified, claims must be precisely calibrated to state that the record counts agree rather than asserting population identity.

title: Physical hardware device capacity must be distinguished from runtime-visible allocation limits
what_happened: Prior reproduction documentation reported the GPU environment as RTX 3050 Laptop GPU, 4096 MB VRAM based on an apparent runtime allocation limit, whereas the physical hardware specification is an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU (6144 MiB physical capacity, 6143.5 MiB runtime-visible CUDA memory).
lesson: Hardware specifications must distinguish total physical device capacity from runtime-visible or execution-clamped memory allocations. Documenting a runtime allocation clamp as the physical hardware identity creates confusing contradictions across audit cycles.

title: Lexical search sweeps do not substitute for semantic claim verification
what_happened: Earlier audit sweeps relied on lexical search (grep) for banned phrases to assert zero misleading occurrences, which failed to catch nuanced semantic overclaims or subtle phrasing divergences where prohibited concepts appeared under alternative wording.
lesson: Lexical searches are helpful screening heuristics but cannot replace semantic review of operative claims. Governance audits must evaluate semantic meaning and context in current-authority documents, not merely report zero literal substring hits.

title: Historical decision lineage and chronology must not be confused with current operative policy
what_happened: Historical decisions (e.g. DEC-016 recording CPU fallback and chunk-size alternatives, or DEC-017 recording review-branch status) retained accurate historical context from their creation date, but without clear supersession and chronology notes, could be misread as current operative policy when later decisions (DEC-018, DEC-019, PR #1 merge) established different current execution invariants.
lesson: Decision logs are chronological records where historical entries should remain immutable, but clear supersession and chronology notes must prevent earlier historical positions from being mistaken for current operative policy.

title: Counterfactual invariance on fully-designed masks does not establish label invariance under arbitrary fixed-position masks
what_happened: The cleanroom ProteinMPNN leakage audit demonstrated 100% counterfactual native-sequence invariance under fully-designed de novo masks (chain_mask=1.0), but overgeneralized this finding to an unverified universal claim of absolute protection regardless of mask configuration. In reality, upstream autoregressive decoding preserves S_true tokens at fixed positions (chain_mask=0.0), where zero-filling S_true fixes an Alanine token that conditions subsequent autoregression rather than providing arbitrary-label invariance.
lesson: Empirical counterfactual invariance demonstrated under fully-designed masks does not establish label invariance under arbitrary fixed-position masks. When upstream model architectures conditionally multiplex sampled tokens with reference tokens, the mathematical guarantee must be strictly scoped to the mask configuration exercised.
